request.style: English, male baritone voice, solo with gospel choir, electric guitar, organ, drums, bass, mournful and powerful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The day of Pentecost had finally come
They were all together in one place
Waiting for the promise to be fulfilled
In the quiet of that gathered space

[Pre-Chorus]
Suddenly a sound came from the sky
Like a rushing, violent wind
It filled the whole house where they sat
And the air began to spin

[Chorus]
Tongues as of fire appeared and divided
Coming to rest on each of them
Filled with the Holy Spirit completely
Speaking in other tongues again

[Verse]
Devout Jews from every nation
Living in Jerusalem now
When the sound was heard by the crowd
They gathered in a bewildered hour
Each one heard them speaking clearly
In his own language, strange and true

[Chorus]
Tongues as of fire appeared and divided
Coming to rest on each of them
Filled with the Holy Spirit completely
Speaking in other tongues again

[Bridge]
They were astounded and amazed
Saying look at these speakers here
Are not all these Galileans
Who stand before us with such fear

[Chorus]
Tongues as of fire appeared and divided
Coming to rest on each of them
Filled with the Holy Spirit completely
Speaking in other tongues again

[Outro]
As the Spirit gave them utterance
The world heard the word in its own tongue
